title: head bone
phrases: define named_colors called colors
use merge_points called locator with divisions [32,32,46] with number_of_points_per_bucket 2 with automatic False
define property called iso_actor_property with color [[0.0,0.0,0.0]]
load volume16_reader called volume_reader with data_dimensions [64,64] with data_byte_order_to_little_endian  with file_prefix 'quarter' with image_range [1,93] with data_spacing [3.2,3.2,1.5]
apply marching_cubes to volume_reader called marching_cubes with value [[0,1150]] with compute_gradients True with compute_scalars False with locator [locator]
apply vector_norm to marching_cubes called gradient
apply outline_filter to volume_reader called outline
show lod_image_data the gradient called iso_actor with scalar_visibility True with scalar_range [0,1200] with mapper 'iso_mapper' with property the iso_actor_property
show polydata the outline called outline_actor with mapper 'outline_mapper'
fashion/attach renderer called renderer with actor [outline_actor, iso_actor] with background [0.1,0.2,0.4] with active_camera the camera with light [light]
forge infrastructure with size [250,250] with renderer [renderer] with window_name 'head bone' with render_window 'render_window'
insert camera called camera with view_up [0,0,-1]
insert light called light with position 'position_of the camera' with focal_point 'focal_point_of the camera'
launch visualization

title: hexagonal poly line
phrases: define points called points with number_of_points 6 with coordinates [[0.0,-1.0,0.0], [c,-0.5,0.0], [c,0.5,0.0], [0.0,1.0,0.0], [-c,0.5,0.0], [-c,-0.5,0.0]]
define cell_array called lines with id_list 'computed(sequential(7))' with number_of_cells 1
define property called actor_property with color [[0.941,0.973,1.0]]
build poly_data called poly_data with points the points with lines the lines
show polydata the poly_data called actor with mapper 'mapper' with property the actor_property
fashion/attach renderer called renderer with actor [actor] with background [0.102,0.2,0.4]
forge infrastructure with renderer [renderer] with window_name 'hexagonal poly line' with multi_samples 0 with size [300,300] with render_window 'render_window'
launch visualization

title: hexahedron
phrases: define hexahedron called hexahedron
define property called actor_property with color [[1.0,0.855,0.725]]
build unstructured_grid called unstructured_grid with points the points
show lod_image_data the unstructured_grid called actor with mapper 'mapper' with property the actor_property
fashion/attach renderer called renderer with actor [actor] with background [0.2,0.302,0.4] with active_camera the renderer_active_camera
forge infrastructure with renderer [renderer] with window_name the hexahedron with multi_samples 0 with size [640,480] with render_window 'render_window'
insert camera called renderer_active_camera
launch visualization
